notes: Road centerlines, water and park polygons, and known building footprints are derived from OpenStreetMap. Additional building footprints and mapped street props were fetched using the official OpenStreetMap map API. Height, road width fallback values, facade appearance, parked vehicles, procedural trees and decorations are stylized and not surveyed. Race routes temporarily close mapped streets in this fictional game. School/campus outlines and bridge centre lines retain OSM coordinates. Education points without an outline are labelled only. Bridge deck heights, ramps, railings, gates and architecture are stylized approximations; completeness of real-world landmarks is not guaranteed.
